provenance: Public synthetic rating fixture reused by explicit threshold >=3 as controlled binary relevance; these are not measured clicks or human preferences.
side_information: Fixed teaching metadata, known at serving; an extra input used only by content baseline, not learned from test labels.
selection: max full-candidate validation macro NDCG@2; earliest exact tie
negative_pool: train eligible items minus each user training positives; known nonclick and unexposed mixed; no validation/test-positive filtering
positive_weighting: uniform train user, then uniform positive within that user
tie_break: descending score, then ascending item ID
cold_rule: no feedback for user 6/7 or item 4/5; unknown collaborative score explicitly falls back to training popularity
audit_truth: Complete synthetic relevance labels for every candidate; real unobserved items are not assumed negative.
